Microsoft will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers at VP level and below across teams in the US, Canada, India and the UK - a headcount-reduction program affecting more than a quarter of the 223,000 employees it reported at the end of June, as the company trims costs and retools its workforce for AI.
highlights: Microsoft offers buyouts to ~60,000 workers at VP level and below

Headcount was 223,000 at the end of June, so the offer touches over a quarter of staff
Framed as cost-trimming and retooling the workforce for AI
